Items 5.D and 5.F: Currently, Registrant’s only clients are Opus Fund LLC (“Opus Fund”), Opus Preferred Fund LLC (“Opus Preferred”), Opus Fund International Ltd. (all of the foregoing collectively, the “Hedge Funds” and each, a “Hedge Fund”) and Opus Private Equity Opportunity Fund LLC (the “PE Fund” and collectively with the Hedge Funds, the “Funds”). Each Fund consists of multiple classes (each, a “Class”) that differ from each other based on their investment strategies and, in some cases, additional factors as well. However, the Classes in a Fund are not legally and financially segregated from each other and, therefore, the assets of one Class in a Fund can be obligated to pay the liabilities of a different Class of that Fund. Since the assets across Classes within each Fund are not segregated from each other, for purposes of Form ADV, Registrant counts each Fund as a whole as a single client and does not count each Class within a Fund as a separate client. However, since each Class has a separate investment strategy, Registrant counts each Class as a separate “Account” for purposes of answering Item 5.F(2)(d)­(f). The portion of Registrant’s Regulatory Assets Under Management (“RAUM”) attributed to the Hedge Fund Classes is as of December 31, 2025. For the PE Fund, the Registrant has not yet received from the underlying managers the gross asset value for the respective Classes of the PE Fund as of December 31, 2025, so the portion of the Registrant’s RAUM attributable to such Classes is as of September 30, 2025. Item 7.A: FBE Holdings LLC is a sponsor of real estate-related pooled investment vehicles. FBE Holdings LLC creates affiliated entities to serve as managers (“Real Estate Vehicle Managers”) of these pooled investment vehicles. Including all the Real Estate Vehicle Managers in Section 7.A of Schedule D would lead to an unduly burdensome and lengthy Form ADV filing. Therefore, Registrant maintains a supplemental list of these Real Estate Vehicle Managers not listed in Section 7.A of Schedule D and will provide this supplemental list upon request. Item 7.B.(1): Per the instructions to Form ADV, Registrant has completed a separate Schedule D Item 7.B.(1) for each Class since the value of each Class is determined with respect to a separate portfolio of securities. The service providers listed for each of the Classes are engaged by each Hedge Fund and PE Fund, respectively, and not by each Class thereof. Item 7.B.(1) Question 15(b) for the Opus Fund Classes: Registrant became a registered investment adviser on July 30, 2021. Since that time, Opus Fund only accepts investments from new investors and existing investors adding to their investment from “Qualified Clients” as defined under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 (the “Advisers Act”). However, prior to the effective date of Registrant’s investment adviser registration, Opus Fund accepted investments from investors that are not Qualified Clients.
